architecture_invariance: the exact same T specification and implementation identity must be used for V0,V1,V2,V3; only V varies
forbidden_behavior: branch on case id, evidence filename/path, architecture name/ordinal, oracle value, global case order, or prior-run state
use any source other than V and raw E
infer missing component content from architecture ordinal or harness metadata

input_contract.evidence: one frozen raw evidence object containing only probe and observed_state
input_contract.inheritance_package: one of frozen V0..V3 exact canonical JSON values

steps: parse M; compute canonical SHA256 of M
if I and A are both present and I.structure_sha256 == H(M) == A.bound_structure_sha256, initialize authority_by_key from A.baseline_authority_by_key; otherwise authority_state=UNAVAILABLE

if authority_state is available and E.probe occurs in A.evidence_binding, map the probe to its structure_key and compare E.observed_state with expected_state; mismatch revokes that key only, match leaves authority unchanged; an unknown probe leaves authority unchanged
if D is present, bound to H(M), and authority_state is available, classify each D dependent as affected iff its structure_key is REVOKED, otherwise unaffected; otherwise dependency_state=UNAVAILABLE
if D is present, produce baseline operative output for each dependent by evaluating M on its structure_key
if R is present and dependency_state is available, apply R.on_revoked only to affected dependents and R.on_authorized to unaffected dependents; if R is absent, retain baseline operative outputs
emit successor state containing H(M), authority_state, dependency_state, and operative outputs; emit no oracle labels
